title: Clean Forcing: Drift-Resistant Autoregressive Video Diffusion with a Frozen Base
title_zh: 清洁强制：基于冻结基础模型的抗漂移自回归视频扩散

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate streaming video of arbitrary length by conditioning each new chunk of frames on those already generated. However, they suffer from exposure bias, where a model trained on clean context must continue from its own imperfect outputs, and errors compound until quality collapses within seconds (drift). Existing methods either require cluster-scale base retraining, apply training-free inference corrections with inconsistent results, or train frozen-base correctors for sampling and cache errors. We instead find that drift is largely deterministic and therefore learnable, as holding the noisy state fixed while varying only the history reveals a counterfactual velocity gap that is ∼ 95 % {\sim}95\% systematic across noise seeds. Based on this observation, we introduce Clean Forcing , which trains a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector on the frozen base model to regress this gap, with a closed-loop stage that adds DAgger-style aggregation and a drift-contraction objective to expose the corrector to its own rollouts. Because the clean histories can be the base model’s own single-shot generations, training needs no real videos , and the merged corrector adds no inference cost. In 50 s text-to-video generation, Clean Forcing reduces Δ \Delta -drift from + 11.3 +11.3 to + 1.65 +1.65 without real video and to − 0.16 \mathbf{-0.16} with 40 real clips, improving on the best published result of + 3.57 +3.57 with over 𝟏𝟓𝟎 × \mathbf{150\times} less data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Clean Forcing outperforms prior methods in aesthetic quality and data efficiency with reduced drift for long-horizon video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型通过以已生成的帧为条件来生成每一新帧块，从而生成任意长度的流式视频。 然而，它们存在曝光偏差问题：在干净上下文上训练的模型必须从自身不完美的输出继续生成，误差不断累积，导致质量在几秒内崩溃（漂移）。 现有方法要么需要集群规模的基模型重新训练，要么采用结果不一致的免训练推理修正，要么针对采样与缓存误差训练冻结基模型的修正器。 我们转而发现漂移在很大程度上是确定性的、因而是可学习的：在仅变化历史而保持噪声状态固定时，会出现一个在不同噪声种子下约 95% 具有系统性的反事实速度差。 基于这一观察，我们提出 Clean Forcing，它在冻结的基模型上训练一个 5.9M 参数的 LoRA 修正器来回归该速度差，并通过一个闭环阶段引入 DAgger 式的数据聚合与漂移收缩目标，使修正器接触其自身的生成结果。 由于干净历史可以直接采用基模型自身的单次生成结果，训练不需要真实视频，且合并后的修正器不增加任何推理开销。 在 50 秒文本到视频生成中，Clean Forcing 在不使用真实视频的情况下将 Δ-漂移从 +11.3 降至 +1.65，使用 40 个真实视频片段后进一步降至 −0.16，以少于 150 倍的数据量超越了已发表的最佳结果 +3.57。 大量实验表明，Clean Forcing 在长时程视频生成中降低了漂移，在美学质量和数据效率方面均优于已有方法。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion models ( Wan Team, 2025 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ) generate high-quality clips, making them promising for live content creation, simulation, and interactive world modeling. However, most use bidirectional attention ( Yin et al., 2025 ) and jointly denoise a clip whose length is fixed before generation begins. Playback therefore cannot begin until the clip has been generated. This inherently limits their applicability to real-time streaming and long-horizon video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型（Wan Team, 2025；Polyak et al., 2024）能够生成高质量的视频片段，这使它们在实时内容创作、模拟和交互式世界建模方面具有广阔前景。 然而，大多数模型采用双向注意力机制（Yin et al., 2025），并对长度在生成开始前就已固定的片段进行联合去噪。 因此，必须等整个片段生成完毕后才能开始播放。 这从根本上限制了它们在实时流媒体和长时程视频生成中的应用。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models address some of these limitations by generating frames in chunks, with each chunk conditioned on those generated before it ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Sand.ai, 2025 ; Skywork AI, 2025 ) . This allows rollouts of flexible length and lets playback begin before generation is complete. However, models trained to continue from clean context must condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference. Errors are therefore fed back into subsequent chunks and accumulate over time, often causing the video to drift toward oversaturated, textureless frames within seconds (drift; Fig. 1 , top). This train–inference mismatch, known as exposure bias ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ) , remains a central challenge for AR video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型通过分块生成帧并在每个块的生成中以先前已生成的块为条件，解决了其中一些局限（Chen 等，2024；Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025；Sand.ai，2025；Skywork AI，2025）。 这使得生成可以具有灵活的长度，并允许在生成完成之前就开始播放。 然而，以干净上下文为条件训练以进行续写的模型，在推理时必须以自身不完美的输出为条件。 因此，误差会被反馈到后续块中并随时间累积，常常导致视频在几秒内漂移到过饱和、无纹理的帧（漂移；图 1，上）。 这种训练与推理之间的不匹配被称为曝光偏差（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025；Po 等，2025），它仍是自回归视频生成面临的核心挑战。

paragraphs.en: Existing drift-reduction methods fall into three categories. Base retraining incorporates the model’s own rollouts into training ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ) , which is effective but expensive: the strongest published result uses 136 136 K clips and 16 × 16{\times} H100 GPUs ( Po et al., 2025 ) . Training-free methods keep the weights fixed and modify inference by noising the context ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Skywork AI, 2025 ) , guiding generation against a cleaner history ( Song et al., 2025 ) , correcting the sampling trajectory ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , or managing the cache ( Meng et al., 2026 ) . These methods either treat drift as uniform noise or re-anchor generation to a prediction that multi-step models do not produce, and none that we evaluate reduces drift at 50 s (§ 5 ). Frozen-base correctors learn lightweight corrections, but existing methods target sampling noise ( Yu et al., 2025 ) or cache-approximation error ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , rather than error induced by generated history. Thus, deployed checkpoints still lack an efficient learned correction that directly targets exposure-bias drift.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的漂移减缓方法分为三类。 基础模型再训练将模型自身的 rollout 纳入训练（Huang 等，2025；Po 等，2025），该方法有效但代价高昂：目前最强的已发表结果使用了 136 136 K 段视频片段和 16 × 16{\times} 块 H100 GPU（Po 等，2025）。 免训练方法保持权重固定，并通过以下方式修改推理过程：对上下文加噪（Chen 等，2024；Skywork AI，2025）、以更干净的历史为参照引导生成（Song 等，2025）、校正采样轨迹（Xiang 等，2026），或管理缓存（Meng 等，2026）。 这些方法要么将漂移视为均匀噪声，要么将生成过程重新锚定到多步模型并不产生的预测上，而且我们所评估的方法中没有一种能在 50 秒时减少漂移（§ 5）。 冻结基座校正器通过学习轻量级校正来工作，但现有方法针对的是采样噪声（Yu 等，2025）或缓存近似误差（Peng 等，2025），而非由生成历史所引入的误差。 因此，已部署的检查点仍然缺乏一种能直接针对曝光偏差导致的漂移的高效学习型校正方法。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Clean Forcing , an efficient drift-reduction method for frozen AR video diffusion models. We first characterize history-induced drift by holding a noisy state z t z_{t} fixed and comparing the model’s denoising velocities under drifted and clean histories. This counterfactual isolates the error induced by the generated history, and our analysis shows that ∼ 95 % {\sim}95\% of the resulting velocity gap is consistent across noise seeds, indicating that drift is largely systematic and learnable. Based on this insight, we train a rank-16 LoRA corrector r ϕ r_{\phi} ( 5.9 5.9 M parameters, 0.4 % 0.4\% of the base) to predict this velocity gap while keeping the base model frozen. To expose the corrector to states induced by its own predictions, we introduce a closed-loop stage that regenerates training pairs with the corrector active ( Ross et al., 2011 ) and penalizes the downstream drift caused by each committed prediction. The base model’s own single-shot generations serve as clean references, so training requires no real videos. On a lightly adapted causal Wan2.1-1.3B ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , Clean Forcing reduces Δ \Delta -drift from + 11.3 +11.3 to − 0.16 -0.16 over 50 s on 128 MovieGen prompts ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) . Without real videos, it achieves + 1.65 +1.65 , outperforming the best published result of + 3.57 +3.57 ( Po et al., 2025 ) while using over 150 × 150\times less data. The corrector trains in one GPU-day and merges into the base model without adding inference overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 Clean Forcing，一种面向冻结 AR 视频扩散模型的高效漂移降低方法。 我们首先通过固定含噪状态 z t z_{t}，比较模型在漂移历史与干净历史下去噪速度的差异，来刻画由历史引起的漂移。 这一反事实设定隔离了由生成历史导致的误差，我们的分析表明，所得速度差距中约 95 % {\sim}95\% 在不同噪声种子间保持一致，说明漂移在很大程度上是系统性且可学习的。 基于这一洞见，我们训练一个 rank-16 的 LoRA 校正器 r ϕ r_{\phi}（5.9 5.9 M 参数，占基座的 0.4 % 0.4\%）来预测这一速度差距，同时保持基座模型冻结。 为了让校正器接触到由其自身预测导致的状态，我们引入一个闭环阶段，在校正器激活的情况下重新生成训练对（Ross et al., 2011），并惩罚每次已提交预测所造成的下游漂移。 基座模型自身的单次生成结果作为干净参考，因此训练不需要真实视频。 在经过轻量适配的因果 Wan2.1-1.3B（Wan Team, 2025）上，Clean Forcing 将 128 条 MovieGen 提示（Polyak et al., 2024）上 50 秒内的 Δ \Delta 漂移从 + 11.3 +11.3 降低到 − 0.16 -0.16。 在不使用真实视频的情况下，它取得了 + 1.65 +1.65，优于已发表的最佳结果 + 3.57 +3.57（Po et al., 2025），同时使用的数据少了 150 × 150\times 倍以上。 该校正器仅需一个 GPU 日即可完成训练，并可合并进基座模型而不增加推理开销。

paragraphs.en: We identify that the velocity error induced by a drifted history is largely systematic across noise seeds, which makes the drift correction learnable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，由漂移历史引起的速度误差在不同噪声种子间很大程度上是系统性的，这使得漂移校正具有可学习性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Clean Forcing, a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector trained on a frozen base model to match clean-history predictions at the same noisy state. Training combines a closed-loop stage for DAgger aggregation and drift contraction with a self-teaching procedure that requires no real videos.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Clean Forcing，一个在冻结基座模型上训练的 5.9M 参数 LoRA 纠正器，用于在相同噪声状态下匹配干净历史的预测。 训练将用于 DAgger 聚合与漂移收缩的闭环阶段，与无需真实视频的自教学过程相结合。

paragraphs.en: Clean Forcing eliminates measurable drift using far less data than base retraining and adds no inference overhead. Among the compared methods, it achieves the lowest drift and highest aesthetic score, while ranking second in subject and background consistency, imaging quality, and MUSIQ. It also transfers to an independent base, scales to a 10 × 10\times larger base, and reduces drift in two other AR world models.

paragraphs.en: Video Generation. Early video generation used GANs ( Vondrick et al., 2016 ; Tulyakov et al., 2018 ) or autoregressed over discrete visual tokens ( Yan et al., 2021 ) . GANs offered fast sampling but were difficult to train, while token-based models faced growing generation costs as video sequences lengthened. Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2022b ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) improved training stability and visual quality, enabling large-scale systems such as ( Brooks et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Polyak et al., 2024 ) . Most of these models jointly denoise a predetermined clip with bidirectional spatiotemporal attention ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ; Ho et al., 2022a ; Bar-Tal et al., 2024 ) . Joint denoising promotes temporal coherence, but requires a fixed clip length and delays playback until the full clip is generated, limiting real-time streaming and long-horizon generation.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成。 早期的视频生成使用 GAN（Vondrick et al., 2016；Tulyakov et al., 2018）或对离散视觉 token 进行自回归生成（Yan et al., 2021）。 GAN 采样速度快但难以训练，而基于 token 的模型随着视频序列变长面临不断增长的生成成本。 扩散模型（Ho et al., 2022b；Blattmann et al., 2023）提升了训练稳定性和视觉质量，催生了大规模系统，如（Brooks et al., 2024；Yang et al., 2024；Kong et al., 2024；Wan Team, 2025；Polyak et al., 2024）。 这些模型中的大多数通过双向时空注意力（Peebles & Xie, 2023；Ho et al., 2022a；Bar-Tal et al., 2024）对预定长度的片段进行联合去噪。 联合去噪有助于提升时序一致性，但要求固定的片段长度，并且要等到整个片段生成完毕后才能播放，这限制了实时流式生成和长时程生成。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Diffusion. AR diffusion generates video in chunks, enabling streaming and flexible-length rollouts. However, training on clean histories but conditioning on imperfect outputs at inference creates exposure bias, causing errors to compound into drift. To address this mismatch, Diffusion Forcing trains on frames with different noise levels ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , a formulation that DFoT extends to transformers with guidance over the generated history ( Song et al., 2025 ) . Self Forcing takes a different route by training on the model’s rollouts ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . For interactive generation, CausVid distills a bidirectional teacher into a few-step causal student ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , an approach further developed by Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . MAGI-1 adds noise to clean context during training to reduce exposure bias ( Sand.ai, 2025 ) , while SkyReels-V2 uses Diffusion Forcing and noised, overlapping context to improve long-video consistency ( Skywork AI, 2025 ) . These methods mitigate error accumulation without isolating the prediction error caused by the generated history. In contrast, Clean Forcing uses the frozen model’s own generations to learn the velocity gap between clean and drifted histories at the same noisy state, reducing drift while preserving streaming, flexible-length rollouts, and inference speed.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频扩散。 自回归扩散以分块方式生成视频，支持流式输出和灵活长度的展开。 然而，在干净历史上训练、却在推理时以不完美的输出为条件，会造成曝光偏差，使误差不断累积并演变为漂移。 为了解决这一失配问题，Diffusion Forcing 在具有不同噪声水平的帧上进行训练（Chen et al., 2024），DFoT 将这一形式扩展到带生成历史引导的 Transformer 上（Song et al., 2025）。 Self Forcing 则采取另一条路径，在模型自身的展开结果上进行训练（Huang et al., 2025）。 在交互式生成方面，CausVid 将双向教师蒸馏为少步数因果学生（Yin et al., 2025），Causal Forcing 进一步发展了这一方法（Zhu et al., 2026）。 MAGI-1 在训练时向干净上下文添加噪声以减少曝光偏差（Sand.ai, 2025），而 SkyReels-V2 使用 Diffusion Forcing 以及加噪声的重叠上下文来提升长视频的一致性（Skywork AI, 2025）。 这些方法缓解了误差累积，但并未隔离由生成历史引起的预测误差。 相比之下，Clean Forcing 利用冻结模型自身的生成结果，在相同噪声状态下学习干净历史与漂移历史之间的速度差，在保留流式输出、灵活长度展开和推理速度的同时减少漂移。

paragraphs.en: Mitigating Exposure Bias. In imitation learning, errors caused by visiting self-generated states are addressed by collecting training examples from the learner’s own rollouts ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . Video generation methods take a similar approach by retraining the base on its outputs, using distributional targets ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , reversed rollouts ( Po et al., 2025 ) , and large-scale rollout training ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Shin et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . This improves long-horizon stability, but requires a full model update and 10 4 10^{4} – 10 5 + 10^{5}{+} clips. Concurrent work post-trains few-step generators on matched-state targets from real videos ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Training-free methods instead noise the context ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Skywork AI, 2025 ) , guide generation with a cleaner history ( Song et al., 2025 ) , adjust the sampling path or activations ( Xiang et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2026 ) , or manage the cache ( Meng et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2025 ) . They require no training, but do not reliably reduce drift (§ 5 ). Frozen-base correctors offer a lightweight alternative, but AutoRefiner targets sampling noise ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , while ERTACache addresses the separate problem of cache-approximation error ( Peng et al., 2025 ) . Unlike prior methods, Clean Forcing directly learns the history-induced velocity gap while keeping the base frozen. With at most 340 clips and no real video, it matches or surpasses full retraining in drift reduction and adds no inference cost after merging.
paragraphs.zh: 缓解曝光偏差。 在模仿学习中，访问智能体自身生成状态所导致的错误，通过从学习者自身的回放轨迹中收集训练样本来解决（Ross et al., 2011）。 视频生成方法采用类似的做法，利用分布目标（Huang et al., 2025）、反向回放（Po et al., 2025）以及大规模回放训练（Liu et al., 2025; Cui et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025; Shin et al., 2026; Yang et al., 2025），基于自身的输出对基础模型进行再训练。 这提升了长时程稳定性，但需要完整的模型更新以及 10 4 10^{4} – 10 5 + 10^{5}{+} 段视频片段。 并行工作使用来自真实视频的匹配状态目标对少步生成器进行后训练（Liu et al., 2026）。 免训练方法则改为对上下文加噪（Chen et al., 2024; Skywork AI, 2025）、用更干净的历史引导生成（Song et al., 2025）、调整采样路径或激活值（Xiang et al., 2026; Tian et al., 2026），或管理缓存（Meng et al., 2026; Yi et al., 2025）。 这些方法无需训练，但并不能可靠地减少漂移（§ 5）。 冻结基础的校正器提供了一种轻量级的替代方案，但 AutoRefiner 针对的是采样噪声（Yu et al., 2025），而 ERTACache 解决的是缓存近似误差这一独立问题（Peng et al., 2025）。 与已有方法不同，Clean Forcing 在保持基础模型冻结的同时，直接学习由历史引起的速度差距。 仅使用至多 340 段视频片段且不使用任何真实视频，它在减少漂移方面即可匹敌甚至超越完整再训练，并在合并后不增加任何推理成本。

paragraphs.en: Exposure bias. The model is trained on clean histories but conditioned on its own imperfect outputs at inference, leading to different conditional distributions under the model’s generated rollout history h gen h_{\mathrm{gen}} and the reference history h clean h_{\mathrm{clean}} : p θ ​ ( x ( k ) ∣ h gen , c ) ≠ p θ ​ ( x ( k ) ∣ h clean , c ) p_{\theta}(x^{(k)}\mid h_{\mathrm{gen}},c)\neq p_{\theta}(x^{(k)}\mid h_{\mathrm{clean}},c) ( Ranzato et al., 2016 ; Schmidt, 2019 ; Ning et al., 2023 ; Cui et al., 2025 ) . Because each generated chunk becomes part of the history, errors compound across K K chunks into O ⁡ ( K 2 ​ ε ) O(K^{2}\varepsilon) cumulative error, manifesting as progressive quality drift over longer rollouts ( Ross et al., 2011 ) . paragraphs.en: Clean Forcing converts our measurement into a learned corrector in three steps (Fig. 2 ). First, we show that the velocity error induced by a drifted history is largely systematic across noise seeds and can therefore be corrected by a deterministic function (§ 4.1 ; panel 1). Second, we train a lightweight LoRA on the frozen base to map the drifted-history velocity to the model’s counterfactual clean-history prediction at the same noisy state (§ 4.2 ; panel 2). Third, we close the train–inference gap through DAgger-style data aggregation and a drift-contraction objective (§ 4.3 ; panel 3). Finally, we show that clean references need not come from real videos because the same checkpoint can generate its own drift-free supervision in bidirectional mode (§ 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: Clean Forcing 通过三个步骤将我们的测量转化为一个学习到的校正器（图 2 ）。 首先，我们证明由漂移历史引起的速度误差在不同噪声种子间很大程度上是系统性的，因此可以通过一个确定性函数进行校正（§ 4.1 ；面板 1）。 其次，我们在冻结的基座模型上训练一个轻量级 LoRA，将漂移历史的速度映射为模型在相同噪声状态下对反事实干净历史的预测（§ 4.2 ；面板 2）。 第三，我们通过 DAgger 风格的数据聚合和漂移收缩目标来弥合训练与推理之间的差距（§ 4.3 ；面板 3）。 最后，我们证明干净参考不必来自真实视频，因为同一个检查点在双向模式下可以生成自身的无漂移监督信号（§ 4.4 ）。

paragraphs.en: The teacher requires clean histories, but these need not come from real videos. We evaluate three settings: (a) real clips , for which 40 clips suffice; (b) prompts only , where the checkpoint generates single-shot 5 s clips in bidirectional mode, which avoids autoregressive drift and provides clean self-supervision; and (c) no clean reference , where reference-free distribution matching fails to reduce drift (§ 5 ). Because a bidirectional checkpoint can extend an existing clip but cannot reliably generate from a prompt alone, we causally adapt it using the same synthetic clips and merge the adapter into the base (Appendix A ), after which Clean Forcing corrects the remaining drift, with the two providing complementary improvements (§ 5 ).

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. Our main base is Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan Team, 2025 ) , configured with block-causal attention over 3-latent chunks, a rolling 21-latent KV cache, and a 20-step solver at 832 × 480 832{\times}480 , 16 fps, CFG 6 6 , and shift 8 8 . The adapted base has the rank-64 causal adapter from § 4.4 merged into its weights. We also evaluate Wan2.1-T2V-14B, which is 10 × 10\times larger (Appendix G.1 ), and an independently trained Causal Forcing checkpoint ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) (Appendix G.2 ). The corrector places rank-16 LoRA adapters on the q q , k k , v v , and o o self-attention projections in all 30 DiT blocks, yielding 5.9 5.9 M trainable parameters ( 0.4 % 0.4\% of the base). We initialize the LoRA output matrices to zero, use unit scaling, and train with AdamW at learning rates of 5 × 10 − 4 5{\times}10^{-4} for one-step correction and 2 × 10 − 4 2{\times}10^{-4} for closed-loop training. The causal adapter uses the same projections and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Training uses at most 340 clips (40 real and 300 synthetic); the zero-real-video variant uses only the 300 synthetic clips, versus the 55 55 K source clips and 81 81 K generated trajectories of Po et al. (2025) . The full pipeline, including generation of teacher clips, takes approximately one day on a single NVIDIA GB300 GPU in bf16 and requires at least 48 GB of GPU memory (Appendix A ).

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. Our main evaluation uses 50 s generations from 128 LLM-refined MovieGenVideoBench prompts ( Polyak et al., 2024 ) held out from training. All methods use identical prompt and seed pairs (Table 1 ). We report official VBench scores ( Huang et al., 2024 ) and Δ \Delta -drift, defined as the MUSIQ score ( Ke et al., 2021 ) of the first 20% of frames minus that of the full video ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Po et al., 2025 ) . To check for metric-specific gains, we also report Δ \Delta QualityDrift ( Meng et al., 2026 ) , quality over time ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , color shift, anchored survival ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , and temporal LPIPS (Table 11 ; Appendix C ). We compare dynamic degree and flicker against ground-truth clips. Error bars show the SEM across prompts. Scoring every frame changes MUSIQ by at most 1.8 1.8 and Δ \Delta -drift by at most 0.26 0.26 , without changing the Δ \Delta -drift ranking. Appendix I additionally evaluates in-domain extension using 5 held-out clips extended by 48 latent frames with 3 paired seeds (Table 10 ), and short-horizon quality using 200 VBench prompts at 5 s (Table 12 ).

paragraphs.en: Quantitative results. Table 1 validates our claim that a frozen base can match the drift reduction of models fully retrained at cluster scale. On the shared base, Clean Forcing reduces Δ \Delta -drift from + 11.27 +11.27 to + 1.65 +1.65 without real video and to − 0.16 \mathbf{-0.16} with only 40 real clips, indicating no measurable quality decay over 50 s. Against released, retrained models evaluated on identical prompts, the + + real variant is lower by more than 3 SEM, while the zero-real variant ties them using over 150 × 150\times less data. Even the zero-real variant outperforms the best published corrective fine-tuning result on the calibrated scale, with + 1.65 +1.65 versus + 3.57 +3.57 for R3 † .
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 表1验证了我们的主张：冻结的基础模型能够达到在集群规模上完全重新训练的模型的漂移降低水平。 在共享基础模型上，Clean Forcing 在不使用真实视频的情况下将 Δ \Delta 漂移从 +11.27 降低到 +1.65，在仅使用40个真实片段的情况下将其降至 −0.16 \mathbf{-0.16}，表明在50秒内没有可测量的质量衰减。 与在相同提示上评估的已发布重新训练模型相比，使用真实数据的变体低超过3个标准误，而零真实数据变体在使用少150倍以上的数据的情况下与其持平。 即使是零真实数据变体，在校准尺度上也优于已发表的最好纠正微调结果，+1.65 对比 R3 † 的 +3.57。

paragraphs.en: Drift reduction does not trade off overall quality. Every VBench dimension improves except motion smoothness, which decreases by 2.0 2.0 points as dynamic degree rises from 29.7 29.7 to 49.2 49.2 : frame-difference metrics reward stillness, so recovering motion costs smoothness (Appendix C ). On our adapted base, Clean Forcing improves subject consistency and imaging quality by 15–16 points and raises prompt adherence from 58.8 58.8 to 70.3 70.3 / 69.9 69.9 , comparable to the distilled model’s 70.1 70.1 (Table 13 ). Its aesthetic score reaches 61.4 61.4 on this base and a table-leading 62.9 62.9 on the Causal-Forcing base. Quality also remains stable when the same videos are evaluated at 10, 30, and 50 s (Table 14 ). SkyReels remains strongest in consistency and smoothness, two dimensions that benefit from large-scale base training.

paragraphs.en: Clean Forcing recipe transfers without model-specific changes or hyperparameter search. On the independently adapted Causal-Forcing base, it reduces drift by 77 % 77\% , from + 11.99 +11.99 to + 2.80 +2.80 , recovers all consistency and aesthetic dimensions to the level of our adapted base, achieves the highest dynamic degree in the table at 70.3 70.3 , and restores prompt adherence to 71.0 71.0 (Appendix G.2 ). paragraphs.en: Efficiency analysis. At full correction strength, the corrected velocity is exactly the LoRA-merged forward pass, so r ϕ r_{\phi} folds into the base weights ( Hu et al., 2022 ) without changing computation, parameter count, peak memory, or NFE ( Δ ​ NFE = 0 \Delta\mathrm{NFE}=0 ). Wall-clock latency is statistically indistinguishable from the base (Table 5 in Appendix E ), with a 3.5 % 3.5\% increase and Welch p = 0.40 p=0.40 . Merging with a nonconstant schedule α ∗ ​ ( t ) \alpha^{*}(t) is discussed in Appendix E . An unfused corrector adds 35 % 35\% latency, while history guidance doubles NFE and pathwise TTC requires additional denoising passes. Thus, only retraining and Clean Forcing add no inference overhead, and only Clean Forcing is also cheap to train.
paragraphs.zh: 效率分析。 在完全校正强度下，校正后的速度恰好等于 LoRA 合并后的前向传播，因此 r ϕ r_{\phi} 可折叠进基础权重（Hu et al., 2022），而不改变计算量、参数量、峰值显存或 NFE（Δ ​ NFE = 0 \Delta\mathrm{NFE}=0）。 其实际运行时延与基础模型在统计上不可区分（附录 E 中的表 5），增幅为 3.5 % 3.5\%，Welch p = 0.40 p=0.40。 使用非常数调度 α ∗ ​ ( t ) \alpha^{*}(t) 进行合并的讨论见附录 E。 未融合的校正器会增加 35 % 35\% 的时延，而历史引导会使 NFE 翻倍，路径式 TTC 则需要额外的去噪过程。 因此，只有重新训练和 Clean Forcing 不增加推理开销，且只有 Clean Forcing 的训练成本也很低。

paragraphs.en: User study. Following Yin et al. (2025) , 33 raters (29 from Prolific and 4 directly invited) each evaluated 15 randomized pairs of 10 s late-window excerpts ( t = 40 t=40 – 50 50 s), with attention checks and at least 5 ratings per pair, yielding 858 judgments. The + + real variant of Clean Forcing is preferred over the base in 93.0 % \mathbf{93.0\%} of judgments and over Self Forcing in 83.9 % \mathbf{83.9\%} , both at p < 10 − 16 p<10^{-16} . Its comparison with SkyReels-V2 is not significantly different from an even split ( 42.7 % 42.7\% , p = 0.09 p=0.09 ), although SkyReels-V2 is preferred for stability and outputs at 24 fps versus 16 fps for all other methods. Table 16 reports per-question results, and Appendix J details the protocol and catch-trial analysis.

paragraphs.en: We present Clean Forcing, a 5.9M-parameter LoRA corrector that learns the same-state velocity gap between drifted and clean histories, is refined on its own rollouts, and merges into the frozen base without inference overhead. Because ∼ 95 % \sim 95\% of this gap is systematic, Clean Forcing matches cluster-scale retraining over 50 s using over 150 × 150\times less data, while its zero-real-video variant achieves Δ \Delta -drift of + 1.65 +1.65 . Future work could apply the same loss during causal adaptation (Appendix F ) or combine clean-history supervision with distribution matching to preserve progression. Exposure bias need not be trained away when its effects can be measured and corrected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Clean Forcing，一个 5.9M 参数的 LoRA 校正器，它学习漂移历史与干净历史之间同一状态下的速度差，并在自身生成的 rollout 上进行细化，最终合并到冻结的基础模型中且不产生推理开销。 由于约 95% 的这一速度差是系统性的，Clean Forcing 使用少 150 倍以上的数据即可在 50 秒内匹敌集群规模的重新训练，其零真实视频变体实现了 +1.65 的 Δ 漂移。 未来的工作可以在因果适应（附录 F）期间应用相同的损失，或将干净历史监督与分布匹配相结合以保持进展。 当暴露偏差的影响可以被测量并加以纠正时，就无需通过训练将其消除。

paragraphs.en: A drift metric can improve even when the generated video deteriorates. Several baselines illustrate distinct ways this happens. Naive LoRA fine-tuning obtains subject-consistency and imaging scores of 66.0 66.0 and 58.5 58.5 , but its output becomes nearly static: dynamic degree falls to 12.5 12.5 on the finals set and 5.2 5.2 in domain. History guidance reaches 94.5 94.5 motion smoothness at a dynamic degree of only 0.8 0.8 . At the opposite extreme, collapsing unadapted rollouts register dynamic degrees of 81 81 – 100 100 because unstable changes count as motion. Pathwise TTC likewise reaches 64 64 – 71 71 , roughly 2.2 × 2.2\times the base, although its outputs are blurred. paragraphs.en: Scaling the base instead. Figure 6 evaluates uncorrected bases after 4K–20K causal adaptation steps using the same data and training recipe. Quality continues to improve through 20K, with a substantial gain between 14K and 20K. The corrected 4K base nevertheless reaches 66.9 66.9 MUSIQ, above the uncorrected checkpoints on this curve, with 1,400 corrector updates versus 16,000 additional adaptation steps. paragraphs.en: Results. On the paired in-domain extension task (Table 6 ), correction reduces saturation drift by 67 67 – 70 % 70\% on the unadapted 14B and 60 60 – 63 % 63\% on the adapted base, with gains of up to 43 points in late-window MUSIQ. paragraphs.en: Setup. To test transfer beyond our causal adaptation, we apply the same recipe to the released chunkwise autoregressive teacher from Causal Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . It shares the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B architecture and three-latent chunk structure with our base; all 825 checkpoint tensors load strictly. Its independent training uses teacher forcing, so the model sees clean ground-truth history rather than its own generated context. It produces sharp early frames, with first-20% MUSIQ of about 64 64 , but its 50 s rollouts deteriorate within 10–15 s and reach Δ = + 11.99 \Delta=+11.99 (Table 1 ). This separates strong short-clip quality from robustness under self-generated history.
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建。 为测试超出我们因果适配范围的迁移能力，我们将同样的方法应用于 Causal Forcing（Zhu 等，2026）发布的分块自回归教师模型。 它与我们的基础模型共享 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 架构和三潜变量分块结构，全部 825 个检查点张量均可严格加载。 其独立训练采用教师强制，因此模型看到的是干净的真实历史，而非其自身生成的上下文。 它能生成清晰的早期帧，前 20% 的 MUSIQ 约为 64，但其 50 秒的 rollout 在 10–15 秒内退化，达到 Δ=+11.99（表 1）。 这说明强大的短片段质量与自生成历史下的鲁棒性是相互独立的。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. Because the release does not specify a complete inference configuration, we evaluate it using our fixed setup: a rolling 21-latent KV window without an attention sink, 20-step UniPC sampling, and seed equal to the prompt index. This differs from its 50-step sampling default. We therefore also test alternative cache configurations on the same 16 prompts (Table 8 ) to assess how much this choice affects the comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 由于该发布版本未给出完整的推理配置，我们使用固定设置对其进行评估：采用滚动 21-latent KV 窗口且无注意力汇聚点（attention sink）、20 步 UniPC 采样，并将种子设为提示词索引。 这与其默认的 50 步采样不同。 因此，我们还在相同的 16 个提示词上测试了其他缓存配置（表 8），以评估这一选择对比较结果的影响程度。

paragraphs.en: Inference robustness. A full KV cache without eviction increases drift relative to the rolling window, from + 11.07 +11.07 to + 16.34 +16.34 on the subset. Attention sinks improve the uncorrected base, reaching + 5.29 +5.29 with a half-window sink; context noise worsens it to + 12.59 +12.59 . Under the rolling-window protocol, the corrector reaches + 3.94 +3.94 on those prompts. Combining correction with the half-window sink reduces drift further to + 3.23 +3.23 . Thus, the correction helps under the fixed protocol and remains useful alongside the strongest cache setting tested. These cache comparisons do not establish the best possible inference configuration for the released checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 推理鲁棒性。 不做淘汰的完整 KV 缓存会加大相对于滚动窗口的漂移，在该子集上从 +11.07 增加到 +16.34。 注意力汇聚点可改善未校正的基线，使用半窗口汇聚点时达到 +5.29；上下文噪声会使其恶化到 +12.59。 在滚动窗口协议下，校正器在这些提示上达到 +3.94。 将校正与半窗口汇聚点相结合，可进一步将漂移降低至 +3.23。 因此，校正在固定协议下有所帮助，并且在所测试的最强缓存设置下仍然有效。 这些缓存比较并未确定已发布检查点的最佳可行推理配置。

paragraphs.en: Diagnostic and result. Before corrector training, the systematic fraction is high across timesteps, α ∗ ​ ( t ) ∈ [ 0.93 , 0.99 ] \alpha^{*}(t)\in[0.93,0.99] (Fig. 7 ), and the preliminary drift measurement is Δ = + 10.83 \Delta=+10.83 . Both indicate substantial room for correction. On the full 128-prompt evaluation, one 36-hour run with a one-step stage, one DAgger round, and 600 closed-loop steps reduces drift from + 11.99 +11.99 to + 2.80 +2.80 ( 77 % 77\% ) and increases MUSIQ from 52.0 52.0 to 62.1 62.1 , without a model-specific hyperparameter search or checkpoint selection.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断与结果。 在校正器训练之前，系统性偏差在各个时间步上都较高，α^{*}(t)∈[0.93,0.99]（图 7），且初步的漂移测量为 Δ=+10.83。 两者都表明存在很大的校正空间。 在完整的 128 个提示词评估中，一次包含单步阶段、一轮 DAgger 和 600 个闭环步数的 36 小时运行，将漂移从 +11.99 降低到 +2.80（降低 77%），并将 MUSIQ 从 52.0 提高到 62.1，且无需针对特定模型的超参数搜索或检查点选择。

paragraphs.en: The corrected checkpoint also improves subject consistency from 64.9 64.9 to 81.8 81.8 , background consistency from 75.7 75.7 to 87.9 87.9 , aesthetics from 45.8 45.8 to 62.9 62.9 , dynamic degree from 33.6 33.6 to 70.3 70.3 , and prompt adherence from 57.5 57.5 to 71.0 71.0 (Tables 1 and 13 ). Increased dynamic degree rules out simply freezing the output. The quality curve remains comparatively stable over 50 s (Fig. 9 ), while lagged identity improves and the cut rate falls by roughly a factor of three (Table 15 ). Compared with our primary corrected base, this external base retains more residual drift ( + 2.80 +2.80 versus + 1.65 +1.65 ) and lower absolute MUSIQ ( 62.1 62.1 versus 66.9 66.9 ), so successful transfer does not imply identical final quality.

paragraphs.en: Artifacts across bases. The corrected Causal-Forcing rollouts exhibit the same luminance pulse at the three-latent chunk cadence as our primary system (Appendix L ). Periodogram power at that cadence exceeds broadband power in both the uncorrected and corrected runs, with ratios of 309 309 and 693 693 , respectively; neither has a corresponding peak at the 21-latent window cadence. This association with chunk boundaries across two bases suggests an artifact of chunked generation, although correction can make it more visible by reducing background degradation. Anchoring is likewise similar to the primary corrected base (last-fifth DINO similarity 0.680 0.680 versus 0.679 0.679 ; Table 15 ), while motion energy remains stable from the first fifth to the last in both arms.
paragraphs.zh: 跨基座的伪影。 修正后的 Causal-Forcing（因果强迫）rollout 在三个潜变量块（latent chunk）的节奏上表现出与主系统相同的亮度脉冲（附录 L）。 在该节奏上，未经修正和修正后的运行的周期图功率均超过宽带功率，比值分别为 309 309 和 693 693；两者在 21 个潜变量窗口的节奏处均无对应峰值。 这种与跨两个基座的分块边界（chunk boundaries）的关联提示这是分块生成的伪影，尽管修正可以通过减少背景退化使其更加明显。 锚定（Anchoring）同样与主修正基座相似（最后五分之一段的 DINO 相似度为 0.680 0.680，对比 0.679 0.679；表 15），而两组中运动能量从第一个五分之一段到最后一个五分之一段均保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Capacity and placement. Table 9 changes the corrector architecture while holding the objective, data, and evaluation protocol fixed. paragraphs.en: Interpretation. The + + real variant is preferred overall to the adapted base in 93.0 % 93.0\% of judgments and to Self Forcing in 83.9 % 83.9\% . Its 42.7 % 42.7\% preference rate against SkyReels-V2 does not differ significantly from an even split ( p = 0.09 p=0.09 ). On temporal stability, raters prefer our method to the drifting base ( 81.8 % 81.8\% ), report no clear preference against Self Forcing ( 46.9 % 46.9\% ), and favor SkyReels-V2 ( 21.0 % 21.0\% for ours). SkyReels-V2 also runs at 24 fps, compared with 16 fps for the other evaluated videos, which may affect perceived smoothness. These judgments concern late excerpts and should not be read as whole-video preferences. Rater instructions, anonymized responses, and the analysis script were released with the code.
